title: How Far Ahead Should You Order Your Cake?
excerpt: The short answer: sooner than you think. Here is how much time different cakes need and why it makes your day calmer.
content:
Nobody wants to be chasing a cake the night before a celebration. A little time up front makes everything smoother, for you and for our bakers.

## Simple birthday cakes

A classic birthday cake can often be done in just a few days, so order as soon as you know the date. If you can give us more notice, we can say yes to more flavours, colours and finishing touches.

## Tiered and wedding cakes

Tiers, sugar flowers and hand painting take real time. If you are planning a wedding, an introduction or a big milestone party, reach out as early as you can. We would much rather talk through your ideas calmly than rush them.

## Sculpted and sugar art cakes

Cakes shaped like handbags, cars, pots or favourite characters are built layer by layer and finished by hand. These need the most notice of all, so book them first and plan the rest of your party around them.

## A tip from the kitchen

If your date is close, do not give up. Send us your idea on WhatsApp or through the order page and we will tell you honestly what we can do in the time you have.

Ready to start? Pick a design from our gallery and place your order whenever you are ready.

title: How Much Cake Do You Actually Need?
excerpt: Too little cake is stressful and too much is wasteful. A few easy questions will get you to the right size.
content:
Choosing a size is one of the hardest parts of ordering a cake, mostly because nobody wants to run out. Here is how we think it through with our customers.

## Start with your guest list

Count the people who will really be there, then think about whether cake is the only dessert. If you are also serving other sweets, you can order a little smaller. If the cake is the star of the day, go a little bigger.

## Think about who is eating

A children's party and a wedding reception eat very differently. Kids often want a small slice and then go back to the games. At a wedding, people usually enjoy a proper portion and some take a slice home.

## Tiers look bigger than they are

A tall, dramatic cake can still be quite modest in size, and a wide, simple cake can feed a crowd. Tell us how many guests you expect and the look you love, and we will suggest a size that gives you both.

## Still unsure?

That is completely fine. Message us with your guest numbers and your date, and we will help you choose. Sizes are approximate, so a quick chat always beats guessing.

title: From Your Idea to Your Table: How Ordering Works
excerpt: Curious what happens after you press send? Here is the whole journey, from your first idea to the moment you cut the cake.
content:
Ordering a custom cake should feel exciting, not confusing. Here is how it works with us, step by step.

## 1. Choose a design

Browse our gallery and open any cake you like. Every design has its own page with a short story and an Order button. If you have your own idea, upload a photo with your order and tell us what you would like to change.

## 2. Tell us the details

Share your date, the size you have in mind, the flavour you want and any special wishes. The more you tell us, the closer we get to what you pictured.

## 3. We confirm everything with you

Our team looks at your design and confirms the details and the price with you before you pay anything. If something needs adjusting, we will talk it through together.

## 4. Follow your order

Once your order is in, you can check its progress any time on our Track Order page using your order reference and phone number.

## 5. Collect or have it delivered

Collect your cake from our bakery in Nsambya, or choose delivery and we will bring it to you in Kampala and nearby areas.

When you are ready, we would love to bake your story.

title: Saw a Cake You Love? We Can Make It Yours
excerpt: Bring us a photo, a Pinterest board or even a rough sketch. Here is how we turn inspiration into a cake that is truly yours.
content:
Most of our favourite cakes started with someone saying, "I saw this, can you do something like it?" The answer is yes.

## Show us what you love

Attach a photo when you place your order. It can be a cake you spotted online, a colour palette, or even a dress or an invitation you want the cake to match.

## Tell us what to change

You might love the shape but want different colours, or like the flowers but need a smaller size. Tell us what to keep and what to tweak, and we will make it your own rather than a copy.

## Be honest about your budget and your date

Some designs take many hours of hand work. If something looks like it needs more time or money than you planned, we will suggest simpler ways to get the same feeling.

## Our gallery is a great starting point

Each cake in our gallery has a button to order that exact design, and a section of similar cakes underneath so you can compare ideas side by side.

Send us your inspiration and we will take it from there.

title: Allergies and Cakes: What to Tell Your Baker
excerpt: A celebration should be safe and joyful for everyone at the table. Here is what you should tell us and what we can honestly promise.
content:
If someone you love has an allergy, please tell us when you place your order. It helps us plan and it helps us give you honest advice.

## What to tell us

Let us know which ingredient is a problem and how serious the reaction can be. If you are ordering for a child or a guest of honour, mention that too.

## What we can promise

Our kitchen works with wheat, eggs, dairy and nuts. Because of that, we cannot promise that any cake is completely free of these ingredients. We would rather be upfront with you than offer a guarantee we cannot keep.

## What we can do

We can talk through the ingredients in a flavour, suggest options with fewer of the ingredients you want to avoid, and take extra care while preparing your cake.

## For serious allergies

If an allergy is severe, please speak with a doctor about whether a bakery cake is safe for that person. Your guest's wellbeing always comes before the cake.

When in doubt, message us. A quick conversation makes everyone more comfortable.

title: Planning a Wedding or Introduction Cake
excerpt: Tiers, sugar flowers and a cake that looks like it belongs in your photos. Here is how to start planning yours without the stress.
content:
Your wedding or introduction cake is one of the first things guests notice and one of the last things they remember. Here is how to plan it well.

## Begin with the feeling

Before you think about tiers, think about the mood. Is your day soft and romantic, bold and colourful, or classic and elegant? Share a photo of your dress, your decor or your colours and we can build the cake around them.

## Decide on tiers and size

Tiers add height and drama, but they also add time. Start from your guest count, then choose how tall and how detailed you want the cake to be.

## Flowers and finishing touches

Sugar flowers, painted textures and gold accents are all made by hand. They look wonderful, and they need time, so we recommend talking to us early about which details matter most to you.

## Book early

Wedding season fills up quickly. As soon as you have your date, send us your ideas so we can set it aside for you.

We are here for every kind of celebration, from kwanjula to white weddings. Tell us your story and we will bake it beautifully.
